name: MangaDex
description: Browse and read manga from MangaDex with localized titles, descriptions, and chapter languages.

zh-Hans.description: 浏览和阅读 MangaDex 漫画，支持多语言标题、简介和章节。

zh-Hant.description: 瀏覽和閱讀 MangaDex 漫畫，支援多語言標題、簡介和章節。

ja.description: MangaDex の漫画を閲覧・読書。多言語のタイトル、あらすじ、チャプターに対応。

configs.name: Browsing languages
configs.description: Comma-separated MangaDex language codes for browsing and search (e.g. en,zh-hk). The source default is English. All readable chapter languages remain available in manga details. zh is Simplified Chinese, zh-hk is Traditional Chinese.

configs.name: Include mature titles
configs.description: Include erotica and pornographic titles in browsing and search. The Mature genre explicitly searches those ratings.
